rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides complete access to X.com's (formerly Twitter) API v2 through OAuth 2.0 authentication, implementing all 21 Post-related endpoints including lookup, creation, deletion, search, timelines, retweets, likes, and bookmarks. Built with TypeScript using comprehensive Zod validation schemas, it covers the full spectrum of X.com operations from basic post management to advanced features like hiding replies, post counts with time bucketing, and user engagement tracking. The implementation supports both read and write operations with proper scope requirements, handles pagination and field expansions, and includes Docker deployment options, making it valuable for social media management, content analysis, automated posting workflows, and X.com data research applications.
